title: Espelho Casual
prompt: Mirror selfie shot. Subject stands in front of a mirror, casually adjusting clothing. Natural posture, relaxed expression. Subtle phone movement.

title: Giro e "Pose" de Modelo
prompt: From 0.0s to 0.5s, the person stands facing front, smiling at the camera with arms relaxed at her sides. From 0.5s to 2.0s, she performs a full 360-degree spin to her left, letting her arms swing outward as her torso and jacket rotate. From 2.0s to 4.1s, she completes the turn facing forward, places her right hand on her hip, and brings her left hand up to rest lightly against the left side of her neck while holding a steady smile. From 4.1s to 7.8s, she lowers both hands to grip the front edges of her jacket at waist height, adjusting them while maintaining her forward pose.

title: Vem Ver
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.167s, the person faces front smiling, reaching both hands forward toward the camera with open palms in a beckoning motion. From 1.167s to 3.333s, she drops her hands and sways her hips side to side, stepping rhythmically with a wide smile. From 3.333s to 5.5s, she raises both hands and points index fingers inward toward her chest, grooving with active shoulder and hip bounces. From 5.5s to 7.833s, she lowers her hands into her front jeans pockets, holding a confident smile while facing forward. The framing remains static throughout.

title: Caminhada Casual
prompt: From 0.0s to 0.8s, the person stands facing the camera, briefly clasping their hands at waist height before releasing them to their sides. From 0.8s to 2.5s, they step forward toward the lens while reaching their right arm out toward the camera. From 2.5s to 4.5s, they pause close to the camera, looking straight ahead before turning their head to the left. From 4.5s to 7.8s, they turn 180 degrees to their left and walk away from the camera down an aisle. The camera operates handheld, tracking back as the person approaches.
camera_note: The handheld camera moves back as the person approaches between 0.8s and 4.5s.

title: Espera final casual
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.0s, the person stands facing the camera with one hand resting on the hip, smiling warmly. From 1.0s to 2.0s, the head turns slowly to the left while maintaining a wide smile. From 2.0s to 2.8s, the head turns back to face front as the hand transitions from the hip up toward the collarbone. From 2.8s to 4.8s, the hand holds near the upper chest while the face smiles directly into the lens. From 4.8s to 5.6s, the hand lowers back down. From 5.6s to 7.8s, the hand rests firmly on the hip again while holding a poised, stationary pose.

title: Dancinha TikTok 5
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.0s, in a waist-up frontal shot, the person smiles directly at the camera while keeping arms relaxed at the waist. From 1.0s to 4.3s, she struts forward toward the camera, swaying her hips gently and swinging her arms in rhythm with her steps while maintaining a broad smile. From 4.3s to 7.0s, she brings her hands together at chest height and rubs her palms together repeatedly, shifting her weight side to side as her smile brightens. From 7.0s to 7.8s, she lowers her hands back down toward her sides while continuing to walk forward toward the camera. The framing never changes.

title: Mudança natural de atenção
prompt: In a waist-up framing, from 0.0s to 2.0s, the person stands with their right hand rested on their hip, looking off-camera to their left with a warm smile. From 2.0s to 4.0s, they rotate their torso to their right, dropping their right arm while turning their head over their left shoulder to gaze directly into the camera lens. From 4.0s to 5.5s, they pivot back to face full frontal, bringing both arms down. From 5.5s to 7.8s, they place their left hand on their left hip and hold a confident, cheerful smile.

title: Olhar Curioso e Sorriso
prompt: From 0.0s to 0.8s, the person stands facing forward, bringing hands together across the waist in a relaxed clasp while looking directly at the camera. From 0.8s to 1.6s, they tilt their head left, cast their gaze down, and release their hands back down to their sides. From 1.6s to 2.8s, they tilt their head right with a curious expression. From 2.8s to 4.5s, they align their head center with arms resting at sides. From 4.5s to 7.8s, they break into a broad smile facing forward as the camera slowly pushes in closer.
camera_note: The camera slowly pushes in from 0.0s to 7.8s.

title: Foco na parte superior do corpo
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.8s, the person stands full-body with hands on hips, smiling at the camera and shifting weight. From 1.8s to 3.8s, the camera pushes in to waist-up framing as she keeps hands on hips and turns her head slightly to the right while looking forward. From 3.8s to 5.2s, in a close chest-up view, she tilts her head back and to the right with eyes closed in a calm expression. From 5.2s to 7.833s, she returns her head upright, lowers her arms to her sides, and smiles directly into the camera.
camera_note: The camera pushes in continuously toward the person from 1.8s to 4.0s.

title: POV - Mãos Segurando o Produto
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.0s, both hands hold the product up in front of the camera, gently shifting it upward. From 1.0s to 2.3s, both hands hold the product steadily at center depth. From 2.3s to 5.5s, the right hand releases its grip from the right side, moves toward the center, and lightly brushes its fingertips downward across the front surface of the product. From 5.5s to 7.8s, the right hand moves back to grasp the right side, holding the product still with both hands.

beats.description: Both hands hold the top edges of a wooden hanger displaying shorts.
The screen-right hand releases its hold and reaches out to gently tap and stroke the fabric surface of the shorts.
The screen-right hand returns to grip the wooden hanger, holding it steadily with both hands.

beats.continuity: The screen-left hand maintains its grip on the hanger throughout.

title: Convite Amigável
prompt: In a waist-up framing, from 0.0s to 0.833s, she stands smiling directly at the camera. From 0.833s to 1.333s, she raises both hands and points her index fingers inward toward her chest. From 1.333s to 3.333s, she shifts her hands downward, pointing her index fingers toward her waist while smiling widely. From 3.333s to 5.333s, she brings both hands up to shoulder level and points both index fingers downwards, pulsing them rhythmically in place. From 5.333s to 6.0s, she lowers her arms back down to her sides. From 6.0s to 7.833s, she holds a steady smile. The framing never changes.

title: Auto confiança
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.3s, the person stands facing forward in a full-body view with hands resting firmly on their hips, legs crossed at the ankles, smiling with gaze fixed on the camera. From 1.3s to 2.1s, they uncross their legs and stand with feet close together while keeping hands planted on the waist. From 2.1s to 7.8s, stepping into a wider stance with hands on hips, they gently sway their hips and torso side to side with subtle head tilts and an open smile. The camera slowly pushes in from 0.0s to 7.8s, shifting framing from full body to three-quarters.
camera_note: The camera slowly pushes in continuously from 0.0s to 7.8s.

title: Selfie Aponta
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.0s, head tilts right, looking forward with a relaxed smile while left hand grips jacket lapel. From 1.0s to 2.8s, eyes blink softly and reopen as smile widens while left hand adjusts the jacket edge outward. From 2.8s to 4.5s, left index finger points directly at chest while head turns slightly left and gaze stays forward. From 4.5s to 6.3s, left hand pulls back briefly before pointing at chest again with an open smile. From 6.3s to 7.8s, left hand lowers, head tilts right, and eyes close gently at the end. Framing stays constant throughout.
camera_note: The camera is held in a selfie position with slight natural handheld movement throughout.

title: Ênfase na altura da cintura
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.3s, the person stands facing the camera with a wide smile, arms resting at her sides. From 1.3s to 2.8s, she shifts her hips and brings her left hand up to rest on her left hip. From 2.8s to 5.0s, as the camera pushes in, she brings her right hand up to place on her right waist. From 5.0s to 6.8s, with both hands on her waist, she turns her torso slightly to the left to pose while keeping her gaze fixed on the camera. From 6.8s to 7.8s, she rotates her torso back toward the front, holding her hands on her waist.
camera_note: The camera pushes in closer from 0.0s to 5.0s.

title: Espelho Textura
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.5s, in a waist-up mirror view, she looks forward with a smile, raising her left hand to place her fingertips on her upper chest. From 1.5s to 3.0s, the camera pushes in closer as her gaze drops slightly, and her fingers gently stroke across her collarbone area. From 3.0s to 6.0s, she continues lightly tapping her chest with her left hand while maintaining a soft smile. From 6.0s to 7.8s, the camera pulls back out to the original framing as she lowers her left hand and looks directly back into the lens.
camera_note: The camera pushes in closer from 1.8s to 3.0s and pulls back out between 6.0s and 7.8s.

title: Selfie Sorriso
prompt: In a close-up selfie framing, from 0.0s to 1.0s, the person smiles into the camera and winks with her right eye while gripping her jacket lapel with her left hand. From 1.0s to 2.333s, she tilts her head toward her shoulder and gently strokes the collar with her fingers, closing her eyes briefly. From 2.333s to 5.0s, she holds the jacket lapel near her chest, smiling warmly into the lens while making minor head tilts. From 5.0s to 7.833s, she releases the collar, drops her hand, and continues smiling at the camera with occasional blinks. The camera experiences subtle handheld shake throughout.
camera_note: The camera experiences slight handheld movement throughout the clip.

title: Dancinha TikTok 3
prompt: From 0.0s to 0.667s, the person smiles at the camera, raising both hands to chest height to form a heart shape with their fingers. From 0.667s to 2.5s, they cross their forearms at chest level, rolling their wrists repeatedly while swaying their shoulders and torso side to side. From 2.5s to 3.833s, they lower their arms and continue swaying rhythmically with a broad smile. From 3.833s to 5.5s, they extend both arms straight forward, pointing index fingers directly at the camera. From 5.5s to 7.833s, they pull their hands back, pointing both index fingers inward at their chest. Waist-up framing; camera remains static throughout.

title: Movimento Lateral Sutil
prompt: From 0.0s to 1.3s, the person smiles while placing both hands on their hips, turning gaze toward the camera. From 1.3s to 2.6s, they maintain the pose with hands on hips, smiling cheerfully. From 2.6s to 4.0s, they slide their hands down to their sides while shifting weight and swaying hips rhythmically. From 4.0s to 5.5s, they tilt their head back and to the left, closing their eyes slightly while keeping a soft smile. From 5.5s to 7.8s, they return their head upright, glance right, then gaze back directly into the lens. The waist-up framing never changes.
